I can confirm on 4.7 dev 2 and latest master [65e73b3a5eec19e3269809b0f00e73a646723067]. The behavior changes accordingly with the point i delete, if i delete the first point, Godot will perma freeze because get stuck on this loop: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e73b3a5eec19e3269809b0f00e73a646723067/scene/3d/spline_ik_3d.cpp#L389 while the loop increases `i`, this code is always called which makes `i` forever ping-pong without end the loop https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e73b3a5eec19e3269809b0f00e73a646723067/scene/3d/spline_ik_3d.cpp#L472-L474

And if i delete the second point, Godot immediately crashes because attempts to access an invalid index This line makes `neareast` underflow because `point_count` is 1 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e73b3a5eec19e3269809b0f00e73a646723067/scene/3d/spline_ik_3d.cpp#L448 which triggers the crash here as `points` size is 1 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e73b3a5eec19e3269809b0f00e73a646723067/scene/3d/spline_ik_3d.cpp#L478
